notes: Identity independently checked: title, seven named authors, 2024 volume 20(1), DOI 10.20982/tqmp.20.1.r001 and terminal citation match the supplied Couture et al. reference. This is the primary replication report, with Methods, Results and Discussion for Experiments 1–5, not an abstract-only excerpt or a preregistration. No PDF supplied. Original side and unassigned fields are placeholders, not re-extracted. Analytic N derivation: 14 + 14 = 28 participants; two mutually exclusive counterbalancing groups each complete both conditions. Groups are participants, not lists, trials or separate samples per condition. No reported post-grouping exclusions; do not derive N from ANOVA df.
